subject: POC trial RACI & next steps — AuroraDx
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@auroradx.com>, Tom Lee <tom.lee@auroradx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial RACI & next steps — AuroraDx

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the POC/trial: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for extracting structured clinical insights from AuroraDx pathology reports and routing recommendations into downstream workflows.
- Timeline: 2-week hands-on trial (recommended start week of 2026-07-26) + 1 week for evaluation and scoring.
- Environment: Customer-managed Azure subscription (network peering + service principal), Redwood will provide a dedicated trial pool for consistent perf.

Proposed success criteria (attached as AuroraDx_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx):
1) Latency: p95 gen < 250ms for 512-token requests under trial traffic profile.
2) Quality: >90% pass rate on the agreed eval set (TP/FP tolerances defined in sheet).
3) Cost: estimated unit cost <= $0.003/token with initial batching/cache config.
4) Stability: no more than 2 transient errors per 1k requests.

Ownership / RACI (initial ask):
- AuroraDx infra (network, outbound rules, service principal): Assign an infra owner we can coordinate with.
- AuroraDx app/product (evaluation data, success criteria sign-off): Samira / Tom (product).
- AuroraDx security/compliance (data handling/retention, SOC2 evidence): procurement@auroradx.com or security@auroradx.com.
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead, commercial), Lauren (CS/implementation), Aditya (network/infrastructure engineer).

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) AuroraDx to confirm infra owner and procurement contact (reply inline).
2) Redwood to share SOW draft + standard trial terms (SOW-AuroraDx-draft.docx attached) — Lauren will own.
3) Exchange minimal network details (IP ranges, firewall rules) so Aditya can validate connectivity.
4) Agree on POC start date (target 2026-07-26).

Attachments: AuroraDx_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, SOW-AuroraDx-draft.docx

If that looks good I can draft a short mutual action plan and calendar invites.

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the following from AuroraDx side: 

- We agree with the proposed success criteria; I reviewed the spreadsheet and we'll validate our eval set by Tuesday (2026-07-21).
- Infra owner: assigning Tom Lee (cc'd) as the point for network/service principal setup.
- Procurement/Legal: procurement@auroradx.com (I copied them in a separate email thread and looped procurement directly).

Tom / Procurement — can you confirm availability for a quick connectivity checklist meeting this week? Ideally before 7/23 so we can hit the 7/26 start.

Also, minor ask: can Redwood confirm whether we need any special NSG rules for outbound to your cloud control plane?

Thanks,
Samira

Hi Tom / Samira —

I can own the infra connectivity and will be the point person for Azure setup. Quick checklist to get us ready: 
- Provide subscription ID + service principal (or we can work with a deployable role)
- Confirm NSG/Firewall rules for outbound to these IP ranges: 52.23.145.0/24, 34.200.88.0/24 (we'll supply final list)
- If you have a restricted egress policy, provide the proxy/FW rules we should test against.

I've attached an example network diagram (Azure_Network_Diagram.pdf) showing typical peering and minimal routes.

Proposed timeline from infra side:
- Connectivity validation: 2 business days after we have service principal + test VM (target 7/22).
- POC start: 2026-07-26 (as proposed).
- Trial end: 2026-08-09, evaluation complete by 2026-08-16.

Success metrics we'll measure during the trial: p95 latency, request error rate, cost per 1k tokens; we'll provide a shared dashboard and an exportable report.

I will set up a 30-min connectivity checklist call for Wed 7/21 10:00am PT — Tom / Samira, let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
